description: This file contains unit tests for the LeaveRequestCommentDao class, focusing on leave request comment and leave comment functionalities within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It verifies methods such as searching, saving, and fetching leave request comments and leave comments, as well as retrieving leave request and leave entities by ID.

classes.name: LeaveRequestCommentDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for LeaveRequestCommentDao, testing CRUD and search operations related to leave request comments and leave comments in OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of LeaveRequestCommentDao, sets up fixture path, and populates test data.

methods.name: testSearchLeaveRequestComment
methods.description: Tests the search functionality for leave request comments filtered by leave request ID, verifies order and count.

methods.name: testSaveLeaveRequestComment
methods.description: Verifies saving a new LeaveRequestComment entity and checks if attributes are correctly assigned.

methods.name: testGetSearchLeaveRequestCommentsCount
methods.description: Checks the count of leave request comments matching specific search criteria.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a LeaveRequest entity by ID, including the case where the ID does not exist.

methods.name: testSearchLeaveComment
methods.description: Tests the search functionality for leave comments filtered by leave ID, verifying order and count.

methods.name: testSaveLeaveComment
methods.description: Verifies saving a new LeaveComment entity and correctness of its attributes.

methods.name: testGetSearchLeaveCommentsCount
methods.description: Checks the count of leave comments matching specific search parameters.

methods.name: testGetLeaveById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a Leave entity by ID, including non-existent ID case.
